rationale: Cheap static diagnostic instead of a full run: check syntax and inspect which pyscipopt API symbols the code uses.

command:
cd /app/submissions && python3 - <<'EOF'
src = open('solve.py').read()
old = '''    env = pyscipopt.Env()
    env.setoutdev(io_null())
    model = pyscipopt.Model("packaging", env=env)'''
new = '''    model = pyscipopt.Model("packaging")
    model.hideOutput()'''
assert old in src, 'pattern not found'
open('solve.py','w').write(src.replace(old, new))
print('patched env->Model')
EOF
timeout 300 python3 solve.py
rationale: Patch the known-wrong gurobipy-style pyscipopt.Env() usage to the direct Model API, then run the solver.
